SAMAN Portable manufactures porta cabins in Bareilly as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins — porta cabins, also called portable cabins — since 2009, and completed 500+ projects across India. Units for Bareilly are fabricated at our Greater Noida works and sent by road to sites across the city, the C.B. Ganj industrial estate, and the Parsakhera industrial area. At about 250–280 km, most Bareilly orders reach the site in 3–4 days once the build is ready.

A porta cabin is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives finished and ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof room without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For a city built on furniture and wood units, zari-zardozi and textiles, food and agro processing, and general manufacturing across the C.B. Ganj and Parsakhera estates — plus steady construction across the region — a porta cabin is the fastest way to put a site office, staff room, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our porta cabins

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to resist rust through Bareilly's hot summers and cold, foggy winters. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet or dusty ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays comfortable in both the peak heat and the January cold. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and an MCB distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and internal partitions when a site needs them.

Common porta cabin sizes for Bareilly sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor, guard, or weighbridge cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and stack units in double-decker form where ground space is tight — a common request on packed C.B. Ganj and Parsakhera plots. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and how the cabin will be used and we will suggest a layout that fits your plot.

Where porta cabins are used around Bareilly

Buyers in the Bareilly region use our porta cabins as admin and supervisor offices inside furniture, food, and general manufacturing units in the C.B. Ganj industrial estate (243502), staff and store cabins for units in the Parsakhera industrial area (243502), gate and security cabins for factories and warehouses on the main highways, weighbridge and billing cabins for logistics yards, and portable offices for small workshops across the city (243001). For teams setting up on raw ground, we build hardened site-office porta cabins with heavier flooring and extra power points for tools and equipment.

Customization and price factors

Because every unit is made to order, the porta cabin price in Bareilly depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates far better through the harsh winters), the flooring, and add-ons like air-conditioning, a toilet, a pantry, or extra electrical load for tools. Colour, branding, window and door count, and internal partitions are all your choice. We confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build — so you pay for the cabin you need, not a template. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing: the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry to someone else.

Delivery, warranty, and certifications

Delivery to Bareilly is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 3–4 days once the unit is ready. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our porta cabins carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure — real, verifiable credentials that a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Why buy your porta cabin from SAMAN

Search for a porta cabin on a directory and you get a page of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly — honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and a one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See how we handle porta cabin builds for Bareilly buyers, look at our container office cabins for Bareilly projects, and our work across the northern belt — porta cabins delivered around Lucknow, cabins we supply into Kanpur, and porta cabin projects across Noida — shows the same build quality reaches every site in the region.

Porta cabin or conventional construction for your Bareilly site

Building a permanent site room in Bareilly ties up labour and material for weeks and leaves you with something you cannot move. A porta cabin removes that. It is built at our Greater Noida works to your size and fit-out, then delivered to C.B. Ganj, Parsakhera, or your project ground ready to occupy — no curing time, no site mess. For furniture, food, and general manufacturing units, that speed matters when a supervisor or security cabin is needed now. The steel construction also means the unit relocates cleanly when the work moves, and a single fixed quote covers the finished cabin instead of an open civil estimate. Buyers in Bareilly usually weigh three things — how fast it arrives, whether the price is firm, and whether it can move later — and on all three a made-to-order porta cabin wins.

For Bareilly buyers, a useful enquiry includes the cabin role, preferred size, number of users, and any comfort requirements such as AC provision, toilet, pantry point, or extra insulation. A Parsakhera warehouse dispatch office may need a counter window and document rack, while a C.B. Ganj furniture-unit supervisor cabin may need better dust sealing, more light, and a layout that faces the shop floor. Access also changes the delivery plan, so share the plot approach, gate width, offloading area, and whether a crane or hydra can be arranged locally. With that information we can price the unit, transport, and placement assumptions in one clear quote.

If the cabin will sit beside a wood, food, or packaging unit, mention dust, washdown habits, summer exposure, and shift timing so we can tune the panels, ventilation, door swing, and flooring before fabrication.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver porta cabins to Bareilly and the C.B. Ganj industrial area?
Yes. We manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch by road to Bareilly city (243001), the C.B. Ganj industrial estate (243502), and the Parsakhera industrial area (243502). Transit is usually 3–4 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What porta cabin sizes are available for Bareilly sites?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for packed C.B. Ganj and Parsakhera plots.

What does a porta cabin cost in Bareilly?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the porta cabin be customised for factory, site, and security use?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout, colour, and window and door count to your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For porta cabins anywhere in the Bareilly region, call our North zone team on +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
